record_scope_reconstruction: South Ossetia simplified civilian crossing regime across the administrative boundary, under the recorded election-related scheduled closure. Odzisi–Mosabruni is a supported member of the affected network, not the full network.

source_checks.finding: Original Caucasian Knot account describes the simplified crossing regime closure without enumerating all facilities; scheduled dates are preserved.

Contemporary Council of Europe report reproduced by ICCN identifies daily civilian use of Odzisi/Mosabruni in the relevant 2017 or 2018 reporting period. This establishes applicability, not the closure dates.
Named Razdakhan–Mosabruni border-control node inspected; alias evidence preserved in site note.

sites.name: Odzisi–Mosabruni / Razdakhan crossing
sites.coordinate_method: Fresh OSM API XML node coordinates
sites.precision: Approximate crossing area, about 100 m; not the historical barrier footprint
sites.evidence_note: OSM named Razdakhan-Mosabruni border_control; DRI 2024 report explicitly equates Odzisi-Mosabruni with Razdakhani. EUMM names Odzisi in the 2019, 2022 and 2026 phase evidence.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: South Ossetia simplified civilian crossing regime across the administrative boundary, under the recorded election-related scheduled closure. Odzisi–Mosabruni is a supported member of the affected network, not the full network.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: 20:00 local announcement time at both boundaries; no reported completed reopening. Retained April 8 implementation evidence is compatible with this window but does not convert the end to observed.
